newsitem.title: USA: Neurogen, Wyeth-Ayerst in licensing pact.
newsitem.headline: Neurogen, Wyeth-Ayerst in licensing pact.

text.p: Neurogen Corp said on Tuesday that Wyeth-Ayerst Laboratories, a division of American Home Products Corp has licensed from Neurogen its world-wide commercial rights to ADCI, a small molecule pharmaceutical that Neurogen has been developing for the treatment of epilepsy and related disorders.

Under the arrangement, Neurogen may receive up to $12.5 million in the form of license fees, equity investments and milestone payments and will also receive royalty payments on world-wide sales of ADCI.
Neurogen said it obtained an exclusive license to ADCI from the National Institutes of Health and has been developing the drug for epilepsy and other convulsant disorders.
The agreement announced today is a sub-license by Neurogen to Wyeth-Ayerst of its rights to ADCI, as well as its rights in improved processes for preparing ADCI.
